main_measure.name: pooled excess forward 5-bar return after forecast <= -10 vs holding baseline
main_measure.threshold: confirm if pooled excess < 0 with t <= -2 and negative in >= 2 of 3 coins; reject if pooled excess > 0 with t >= +2; inconclusive otherwise or if < 30 cases

supporting_check.name: number of coins with negative mean excess forward return (need >= 2)

decided_by: The pooled excess forward return is negative with t <= -2 and negative in at least 2 coins, meeting the confirm rule.
reading: The baseline is the mean forward 5-bar return over all bars of each coin and window, the extreme cases are grid bars at positions 0,5,10,... with forecast <= -10, the t is the ordinary t of the pooled mean, and 'at least 2 of the 3 coins' is applied as at least 2 negative coins among the coins present, with a negative t <= -2 lacking that coin support treated as inconclusive.
